goal: Wave 3 build: Role editor; the policy PUT round-trips every field; Gemini tools, schema sanitiser and effort; RoutingPolicy candidate, evaluate, promote; One schedule list NOTE: run every pnpm command with the env var pnpm_config_verify_deps_before_run=false. Typecheck the frontend with node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc6 -p tsconfig.app.json --noEmit (tsconfig.json checks nothing). NOTE: every new switch defaults off; never flip one. A change to any .proto needs generated code: put the exact buf/regen step in lead_todo instead of hand-editing generated Go files, keep the change additive, and comment every new field and message (buf lint ratchet). NOTE: one model-gateway plus execution-core test build takes most of the free disk, so build only the test targets your slice names; never create a new cargo target directory, use only the given targetDir. NOTE: a change to a platform prompt or a tool definition must regenerate apps/Model Plane/rust/crates/mp-contracts/tests/fixtures/prompt-tool-manifest.json (MP_UPDATE_PROMPT_MANIFEST=1 cargo test -p mp-contracts --test prompt_tool_manifest) and add or update an eval case or replay cassette (scenario-touch gate). NOTE: Wave 3 is built in wave mode: build the code and its tests, log depth findings, no live stack and no docker (the lead runs docker). Live proofs go to the depth phase. NOTE: EP-14-S10's session-core migration is 0104_routing_policy_candidates (+ revert), not 0076: round B's C-B2 renumbers round A's 0072-0076 to 0100-0104. EP-14-S10 adds the C3 test that a candidate carrying a roles table (EP-13-S4, now committed in routing_policy.rs) validates and promotes. EP-13-S5 keeps the policy page on PUT. A change to action-registry.ts needs the admission golden regenerated: put 'regenerate agent-action-admission.json' in lead_todo with the new row count; the lead re-vendors it. The inference-core gRPC handlers now call infer_role_noted / infer_stream_role_noted (lead edit after EP-13-S4).

slices.title: Role editor; the policy PUT round-trips every field
slices.summary: Widens the router_policy.update action input with tool_fallback_ladder and roles, and makes RouterPolicyPage keep the loaded document and send it back whole, fixing the existing silent reset of a customised ladder. Adds a 'Modeller for hjelpeoppgaver' section with ordered candidate chips from the chat catalogue, read-only with a 'ikke aktivert' note when /v1/models role_routing is false, and per-row invalid_role_table errors. The ladder round-trip half can ship before S4. No proto, migration or FE flag. When EP-14 S10 flips, this editor moves to propose/promote and the contract is extended, not forked (C3).

slices.title: Gemini tools, schema sanitiser and effort
slices.summary: Adds a JSON Schema to Vertex functionDeclarations sanitiser (inline local refs, drop unsupported keywords, const to enum, type unions to nullable, enum cap; an inexpressible tool is dropped and counted via inference_gemini_tool_dropped_total). Gemini functionCall parts map to tool_calls with synthesised stable ids, tool_choice maps to ANY with allowedFunctionNames, structured output goes through the sanitiser. effort.rs gains Wire::GeminiThinkingBudget and GeminiThinkingLevel with declared_support and honest advertised levels behind INFERENCE_GEMINI_EFFORT_ENABLED (default off). No proto or migration.

decisions_defaults.D5: No thought-signature replay; neither tool loop replays native function-call parts, adapter ignores signatures.

slices.title: RoutingPolicy candidate, evaluate, promote
slices.summary: Adds a pure offline routing_diff over a checked-in synthetic corpus (flags unpriced models and ZDR-route changes), proto additions (RoutingPolicyMessage.candidate_id = 5, SetRoutingPolicyRequest.expected_version = 3, ProposeCandidate/RecordCandidateEvaluation/PromoteCandidate/ListCandidates and PolicyCandidate), and session-core migration 0076_routing_policy_candidates (renumber to 0104 at merge per round B C-B2). set_policy honours expected_version (ABORTED on mismatch); promote requires an evaluated candidate with an accepted diff and either a passing live eval or a waiver reason. With ROUTING_POLICY_PROMOTION_REQUIRED on, PUT answers 202 with a candidate; off is byte-identical to today. Per round A C3 add a test that a candidate containing EP-13 roles validates and promotes. Switches SESSION_CORE_ROUTING_CANDIDATES_ENABLED and ROUTING_POLICY_PROMOTION_REQUIRED, both default off.
slices.remaining: Build dark with both switches off: offline diff, candidate store, expected-version CAS, promote flow. Only flipping ROUTING_POLICY_PROMOTION_REQUIRED waits on D9 (owner decision on replacing the direct PUT); not part of this build.
